name: Narkissos
text: Narkissos (Greek: Νάρκισσος meaning narcissus) is a village in the municipal unit of Fanari in the Preveza regional unit in the region of Epirus, in western Greece. In 2021 its population was 282.

depictions.name: Narkissos
depictions.text: Narkissos was a cave by a lake on Mount Helikon in Boeotia, Greece. During the Peloponnesian War, a pack of wolves had made the cave their home when the Spartan misthios Kassandra was exploring the mountain. She killed the leader of the pack and claimed what valuables laid within the cave.
